description: Sri Lanka Customs- Rates of Exchange with effect from 04.08.2025 to 10.08.2025
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and represents an exercise of statutory powers granted by legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, commercial, or other specialized category.
